ingest.note: Input audio is 24 kHz 16-bit PCM mono via input_audio_buffer.append. Also accepts G.711 μ-law 8 kHz via the pcmulaw input format, which avoids resampling but is lossy.

egress.note: Output audio delta is 24 kHz 16-bit PCM. Resample + encode to μ-law before sending to a PSTN leg (unless using OpenAI's native SIP transport, which carries the call directly).

potholes.note: The Realtime API is GA. Drop the legacy `OpenAI-Beta: realtime=v1` header. Use POST /v1/realtime/client_secrets for ephemeral creds, /v1/realtime/calls for WebRTC, and the new event names (response.output_audio.delta, session.audio.output). Older examples predate GA and will mislead.

OpenAI Realtime now offers a native SIP transport for telephony voice agents. Using it lets OpenAI carry the PSTN leg, removing the μ-law bridge from your code. Only viable if OpenAI is the telephony ingress; you cannot use it with Exotel/Twilio media streams.
On server VAD, speech_started signals barge-in. Stop outbound playback and clear the buffer; coordinate your audio sink with this event.

response.cancel alone leaves already-buffered audio playing. On speech_started also send conversation.item.truncate with the correct item_id and audio_end_ms from your own playback clock, or the caller hears overlapping speech. Track played-audio time per response item — guessing audio_end_ms is the #1 Realtime API bug.
Two valid input formats: 24 kHz PCM (best quality, needs resample from telephony) or μ-law 8 kHz (no resample, lossy). Pick one deliberately; do not mix.
When the model calls a tool, conversation.audio is paused until you return the tool output. Failing to respond stalls the turn.
gpt-realtime-2 adds reasoning. Set reasoning.effort to low for most production voice agents; higher effort adds latency before first audio.

interruption.description: OpenAI Realtime emits input_audio_buffer.speech_started on user speech. This signals barge-in. Stop outbound playback, clear the buffer, and send response.cancel to abort in-flight responses.
interruption.code_hint: On 'input_audio_buffer.speech_started': (1) call response.cancel, (2) flush outbound audio, (3) resume listening. Pipecat/LiveKit handle this automatically.

deployment.self_host_notes: API service — nothing to self-host. Co-locate your worker with the serving region; verify data-residency options for regulated deployments. The native SIP transport can carry the PSTN leg itself (removing your bridge) but only when OpenAI is the telephony ingress.
